primitives.name: Stimulus Compound Patterning
primitives.verbatim_quote: THE PATTERNING OF STIMULUS COMPOUNDS 351 equal success in the reverse direction, making the stimulatory compound into a negative or inhibitory stimulus, while its components applied singly maintain their positive effect.
primitives.assumptions: The components of a stimulus compound retain their individual properties when presented separately, and the compound itself can invert the valence of its constituents.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs when the compound loses its ability to invert valence, reverting to merely additive effects of its components.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Models betting line shifts as compound stimulus patterns where bookmaker adjustments (compound) invert the directional bias of individual bettor signals (components). GSE: Tracks player formation changes (compound) that reframe the effectiveness of basic plays (components), enabling strategic reversals.
layer2.telemetry: Bookmaker directional skew reversal or player formation efficiency spikes.

primitives.name: Woodbury Dick Experiment
primitives.verbatim_quote: In one experiment a dog named "Dick" was placed in a wooden stock much like that employed by Pavlov.
primitives.assumptions: The experimental setup isolates the subject from external distractions, allowing precise control over stimulus presentation and response measurement.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure mode occurs when environmental noise exceeds experimental control, corrupting the stimulus-response mapping.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Maps controlled betting environments (laboratory-like setups) where specific market conditions isolate key betting signals. GSE: Simulates game states in practice settings to isolate the impact of individual tactical elements on outcome.
layer2.telemetry: Market volatility drops to baseline noise levels or practice metrics show pure random scatter.

primitives.name: Bar Activation Threshold
primitives.verbatim_quote: Just in front of the dog's head was a light horizontal wooden bar; when this bar was raised about half an inch it closed an electrical circuit, activating an electromagnetic device which released into a pan before the dog a pellet of appetizing food.
primitives.assumptions: A discrete mechanical threshold (half-inch displacement) translates physical action into a binary reward trigger, establishing a clear stimulus-response contingency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breakdown happens when the threshold becomes ambiguous or when the reward mechanism fails to activate reliably.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Encodes order flow thresholds (e.g., 0.5% price movement) that trigger liquidity injection or withdrawal events, creating discrete reward structures for market makers. GSE: Represents spatial thresholds (e.g., goal-line proximity) that activate goal-scoring probability jumps.
layer2.telemetry: Order flow sensitivity analysis shows flat response curves around key price points or goal-scoring models lose predictive power near critical distances.
